personality_one_liner: An atmospheric, high-tension dark-first operational command center for AI horror video automation and real-time generation.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm with compact tactical padding for high-density generation steps

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on cinematic horror video cards
Apply translucent sticky header blur over scrolling feeds
dont's: Never blur dense telemetry stats or step timelines

screens.name: ProjectFeed
screens.purpose: Overview of AI horror video automation projects, credits, and active generation queues.

states.loading: Centered pulse radar spinner in blood-red
states.empty: Dark atmospheric void with prompt creation CTA
states.error: Tactical alert banner with retry hook

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top credit counter badge, quick prompt launch bar, and active project cards with 9:16 aspect ratio preview thumbnails.

screens.name: CreateHorrorPrompt
screens.purpose: One-prompt orchestration engine to configure style bible, narrative arc, and audio/visual parameters.

states.loading: Analyzing horror premise and extracting characters...
states.empty: Enter a terrifying premise or select a dark prompt template
states.error: Failed to parse scenario parameters. Check network connection.

screens.layout: Single column form with expanding prompt text area, subgenre selectors, and sticky bottom orchestration CTA.

screens.name: JobOrchestrationPipeline
screens.purpose: Real-time stage progress tracking from story generation to FFmpeg assembly and quality checks.

states.error: Pipeline halted on quality gate verification

screens.layout: Vertical stage stepper with live progress bars, WebSocket telemetry logs, and abort/resume controls.

screens.name: MediaPreviewExport
screens.purpose: Preview 9:16 vertical horror video clips, review synchronized subtitles/SFX, and download final package.

states.empty: No rendered video clip available yet
states.error: Stream decoding failed. Tap to re-render asset.

screens.layout: Full-bleed 9:16 video player with floating gradient scrim, subtitle overlay toggle, and dual export/share actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement SpectreAI mobile app using Dark-First Utility DARK personality (Obsidian base #0E1116, signal red accent #DA3633, Barlow Condensed typography for metrics/headers). Ensure all screens adhere to the 9:16 vertical horror microdrama aesthetic with real-time WebSocket progress tracking, credit protection gauges, and FFmpeg assembly orchestration.
